Vorona

Vorona is a genus of Dinosauria placed in Ornithuromorpha in Phylosaur's classification. This page shows where it sits in the dinosaur family tree.

Phylosaur is a daily game: you identify a hidden genus by following clues through this family tree. Genera are ranked by how well known they are, from Level I (very familiar) to Level V (rarely heard of). Vorona is Level II.
